segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״הֲרֵי נְטִיעוֹת הָאֵלּוּ קׇרְבָּן אִם אֵינָן נִקְצָצוֹת״, ״טַלִּית זוֹ קׇרְבָּן אִם אֵינָהּ נִשְׂרֶפֶת״ — יֵשׁ לָהֶן פִּדְיוֹן. ״הֲרֵי נְטִיעוֹת הָאֵלּוּ קׇרְבָּן עַד שֶׁיִּקָּצְצוּ״, ״טַלִּית זוֹ קׇרְבָּן עַד שֶׁתִּשָּׂרֵף״ —
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one sees his property in danger of being destroyed, and takes a vow stating, for example: «These saplings are» like «an offering if they are not cut» down, or: «This garment is» like «an offering if it is not burned,» these items are consecrated if the saplings remain standing or if the garment is not burned. In addition, «they are subject to» the possibility of «redemption» just as other items consecrated for maintenance of the Temple may be redeemed. But if one said: «These saplings are» like «an offering until they are cut» down, or: «This garment is» like «an offering until it is burned,»
then «they are not subject to» the possibility of «redemption.»
